types.label: Missing person
narratives: RP reports a family member missing since {since}, last seen near {near}.
{caller} reports a missing person, last seen {since} at {address}.

types.label: Missing elderly person
narratives: RP reports an elderly relative with memory problems has wandered away from {address}.
Caregiver reports a confused senior missing since leaving {address}.

types.label: Juvenile runaway
narratives: Parent reports a teenager ran away from {address} after an argument.
RP reports their teen has not come home and is not answering messages, last seen near {near}.

types.label: Missing at-risk person
narratives: RP reports a vulnerable person missing from {address} and may be in danger.
Caregiver reports an at-risk individual missing without medication since {since}.

types.label: Juvenile found
narratives: RP reports a young teen alone and upset near {near}, thought to be a runaway.
Caller advises a juvenile matching a missing person report is sitting at {near}.
